newsitem.title: USA: ITT-Tenneco Automotive venture teams with Benteler.
newsitem.headline: ITT-Tenneco Automotive venture teams with Benteler.

text.p: ITT Automotive and and Tenneco Automotive, which have already formed an alliance, said they are teaming with Benteler Automotive to serve vehicle manufacturers worldwide.
ITT Automotive is a unit of ITT Industries Inc and Tenneco Automotive is part of Tenneco Inc.
The companies said they are discussing with a number of global automakers about developing modular chassis systems on a worldwide basis.

Modular chassis systems are fully-assembled units that will incorporate Tenneco Automotive's Monroe ride control products, ITT Automotive brake systems and Benteler sub-frames and structural components as specified by the automakers.

"By combining our alliance's expertise in modular chassis systems with Benteler's technologies, both automakers and consumers will benefit from superior quality, high performance and cost-efficient, affordable vehicles," said Thomas Evans, president of Tenneco Automotive.

On a platform-by-platform basis, any of the three firms can take the lead role as the tier one supplier to the automaker, the companies said. All three are currently first-tier, full-service suppliers of modular chassis systems.
